title: A format indents every row
body:
coax draws markdown inside a gutter. Its markdown view puts `│ ` before every row and adds 2 to each row's `lead` and to every link run's column, and its subagent view does the same with its own indent.

## Proposal

A `Format` setting that puts a prefix before every row and counts it in `lead`, such as `.indent(n)` for blank columns or `.prefix("│ ", style)` for drawn ones. cmr-b88cde lists `indent` as follow-up work.
